cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the sandwiches I've packed. Eat one before the bus leaves; I won't have you setting off hungry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only going to the next town for the afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then save the other for coming back. I've cut the crusts off both, so even the end of your journey will be kind to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're talking as if this is goodbye for good.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here and let me straighten your scarf. If these are the last instructions you hear from me today, I want you warm enough to ignore them happily.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs food and A3 prepares return sandwich; A5 directs scarf care but last instructions today narrows the finality after B says goodbye for good. Status and warmth work; intensifying finality remains uncertain.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2 short trip for return food; A5 responds to B4 concern with another care act, but qualifier today softens rather than grows countdown.

relationship.evidence: B2 limits trip and B4 notices overly final tone, plausible responses to protective fussing.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds personal touch but its last-today wording retreats from B4 perceived permanent goodbye.

specificity.evidence: A1 bus sandwiches and A5 scarf care are concrete; no missing relationship needed.
